notes: Three-ton single-stage R-410A heat pump outdoor unit, 208/230 V single phase (the three-phase RP1436FC1NA has a different compressor and contactor number). Ratings are from the RP1436F column of the Form P11-810 Rev 4 spec sheet: scroll compressor RLA 15.4 A and LRA 83.9 A, outdoor fan motor 1/3 hp, 910 rpm and 2.8 A full load.

gaps: The spec sheet (Form P11-810 Rev 4, printed 8/19) and the parts list (6 February 2017) are different revisions: ratings come from the RP1436F column of the sheet, part numbers from the 36 FJ1NA column of the list.
The 20 December 2019 revision of the list shows the same numbers for every part claimed here.
Compressor and fan motor ratings are in the notes, not on the parts, because each part claim cites one source and the parts list does not give them.
The list gives no ratings for capacitor 43-101666-68, contactor 42-102664-05 or solenoid coil 61-101713-92.
The list also names fan blade 70-101323-41 and condenser coil AS-105093-03 for this column; they are not claimed.
The three-phase FC1NA 36 column uses compressor 55-102045-138S and contactor 42-102664-14; it is not covered.
The maker's rheempartslists.net address named in the list did not load.
method: Rheem RP14 Parts List, 92-42800-RP14, revision 06-February-2017 (26 pages), read from a Gemaire copy that carries Rheem's form number and revision date; the file name mentions RP1418BJ1NA, but the document is the whole RP14 heat pump list.

Parts list PDF p.3 (model explanation: F major series, J = 208-230/1/60) and p.8 (electrical and fan group, 36 FJ1NA: fan motor before and after serial W1017, contactor, defrost board, low-ambient sensor, pressure controls).

Parts list PDF p.11 (coil group: reversing valve, solenoid coil) and p.15 (compressor group: compressor, compressor capacitor). Pages 8, 11 and 15 were also rendered and the 36 FJ1NA column read on the image.

Rheem Form P11-810 Rev 4 (RP14-F Series, printed 8/19), read from an ABR Wholesalers copy: p.3 (SKU list names RP1436FJ1NA, 3 ton), p.6 (model number identification), p.8 (physical and electrical data, RP1436F column, single-phase block).
Form P11-810 Rev 4 also: p.4 and p.5 (composite base pan, louver panels, fan orifice, sleeve bearings) and p.18 (guide specification).
Form P11-810 Rev 1 (printed 2/18), read from Unilog's copy: p.8 shows the same RP1436F values (RLA 15.4, LRA 83.9, FLA 2.8, 35 A, 23 A, 118 oz). Cross-check only.
Rheem RP14 Parts List, 20-December-2019 revision (ABR copy): pp.11, 17 and 21 show the same numbers for the 36 FJ1NA column. Cross-check only.
The ABR host returned HTTP 406 to a plain request; the PDFs were read with the research tool's pdf command.
Repair parts retailers seen in search results were not opened.

comps.spec: Compressor, Rheem part 55-102045-103S (compressor ID 9135), listed in the 36 FJ1NA column of the 2017 parts list
Outdoor fan motor, Rheem part 51-102728-11 before serial W1017 and 51-102728-23 on or after W1017 (36 FJ1NA column of the 2017 parts list)
Outdoor propeller fan, 24 in diameter, 3 blades, 3,120 CFM (36 size).

Outdoor coil of aluminum fins mechanically bonded to copper tubes. 36 size: 3/8 in tubes, 20 fins per inch, single row, outer-coil net face area 19.8. Valve connections 3/8 in liquid and 3/4 in suction; unit furnished with 118 oz of R-410A, enough for 15 ft of line set.
Maximum overcurrent protection 35 A (HACR breaker or fuse) and minimum circuit ampacity 23 A for the single-phase 36 size.
Reversing valve, Rheem part 61-102498-09, with solenoid coil 61-101713-92 (36 FJ1NA column of the 2017 parts list)
Capacitor, Rheem part 43-101666-68, listed as Capacitor - Compressor in the 36 FJ1NA column of the 2017 parts list
Contactor, Rheem part 42-102664-05 (36 FJ1NA column of the 2017 parts list)
Low-pressure control 47-103670-05 and high-pressure control 47-103669-01 (36 FJ1NA column).
Defrost control board, Rheem part 47-102685-07 (36 FJ1NA column of the 2017 parts list)
Low-ambient sensor, Rheem part 47-102709-01 (listed in the 36 FJ1NA column).
Galvanized steel cabinet (guide specification) with formed curved louver panels, a drawn top cover, a composite base pan and a composite fan orifice.
